definitions.gloss: exchange counter; redemption booth; collection point
definitions.explanation: A counter or booth where tickets, vouchers, coupons, or other items can be exchanged or redeemed for goods, services, or cash. Found at events, airports, stations, and amusement parks.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引換所|ひきかえじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where is the ticket exchange counter?

examples.japanese: ⟦{景品|けいひん}→景品：08319_keihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引換所|ひきかえじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A long line had formed at the prize redemption booth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{引換所|ひきかえじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦レンタカー→レンタカー：23193_rentakaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I picked up the keys for the rental car I reserved at the exchange counter in the airport arrivals lobby.

notes:
A compound of {引換|ひきかえ} (exchange, redemption) and {所|じょ} (place, counter). The {所|じょ} suffix creates place nouns: ⟦{案内所|あんないじょ}→案内所：17418_annaijo⟧ (information desk), {受付所|うけつけじょ} (reception), {両替所|りょうがえじょ} (currency exchange).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧{引換所|ひきかえじょ}: ticket exchange counter
- ⟦{景品|けいひん}→景品：08319_keihin⟧{引換所|ひきかえじょ}: prize redemption booth
- {引換所|ひきかえじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive at the exchange counter
- {引換所|ひきかえじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up at the exchange counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: reception desk — a more general service counter
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: service window, counter — a broader term for any service window
- {両替所|りょうがえじょ}: currency exchange — specifically for exchanging money
